FAQ
Frequently Asked Questions
Any confusion? Find your answer here — or WhatsApp us.
📅 When will I get my token after booking?+
After payment verification, your token number, doctor name and exact time will arrive on WhatsApp within 5–10 minutes. No printing or queuing needed.
💊 How long does medicine delivery take?+
Within Larkana district, same day or next day delivery. Remote areas may take 1–2 days. Delivery status shared on WhatsApp.
💳 Which payment methods are accepted?+
EasyPaisa, JazzCash and Bank Transfer (HBL/MCB). After payment, send transaction ID or screenshot on WhatsApp.
🧪 How will sample be collected from home for lab test?+
After booking, our trained rider will come to your home at your preferred time to collect the sample. Rs. 100 home collection charge. Results in 24–48 hours via WhatsApp PDF.
🚨 What to do in an emergency?+
Click the "Emergency Helpline" button above or WhatsApp directly at +92 332 2012057. We are available 24/7 and will respond immediately.
👨‍⚕️ Are doctors verified? Can we trust them?+
Yes — all SK Healthcare doctors are PMDC registered and experienced. Each doctor has a rating system visible on the booking page.
🔄 Can appointments be cancelled or rescheduled?+
Yes — WhatsApp us 24 hours before your appointment. We will reschedule or process a refund.
📍 Which areas have service?+
Currently available across Larkana district — Gambat, Naudero, Warah, Dokri and surrounding villages. Expanding soon.
